title: Paper Shaders
notes: Reference that shaped Scout. React wrapper recorded as the primary install for this pack; the vanilla package is `npm i @paper-design/shaders`. Interactive playground/docs at shaders.paper.design. Apache-2.0, no attribution required.
summary: Zero-dependency HTML canvas shaders — mesh gradients, orbiting-dot patterns, and similar animated effects — installable from npm or designed visually in Paper and exported as lightweight code. Ships a vanilla-JS package (@paper-design/shaders) and a React wrapper (@paper-design/shaders-react), TypeScript throughout, aimed at animated visual effects without heavy dependencies or hand-written GLSL.
surfaces_when: a plan calls for an animated background, hero-section visual, or gradient effect on a web page
adding a mesh gradient, orbiting-dots, or similar canvas shader effect without writing GLSL
replacing a video file or heavyweight animation library that is only serving as a decorative background
ambient_line: Paper Shaders — zero-dependency canvas shaders; use for animated backgrounds and gradient effects.
